source.title: Warhammer 40,000: The App 2.7.1, data build 972, released 2026-10-02

data.summary:
As each player's turn ends, both players resolve these steps, the active player first:

1. Score the VP of each Secondary Mission whose conditions you met, if you choose. With Tactical Secondary Missions, discard each one scored; it is achieved.
2. Then, in your own turn and only with Tactical Secondary Missions, you may discard 1 or more active Secondary Missions; doing so gains 1 CP in total.

detail.order: both players, starting with the player whose turn it is

score.condition: met the conditions of one or more Secondary Missions
